description: Get one model’s typed parameters, options, defaults, required fields, and pricing. Catalog fields such as `session_id` and `previousTaskToken` must be discovered here: a chat continues with the same `session_id` and the next prompt, and `previousTaskToken` with `toolOutputs` continues a turn that ended with tool calls. Fill required parameters and follow the returned `run_model` next action once when the user wants a run; for a price question, the price here is the answer. A price set when the run ends, or turn by turn in a live session, gives the rates, and the charge is known after the run. "No fixed price" means the run is charged for the time it takes. It also describes the built-in workflow utilities (workflow-utilities/output-filter, workflow-utilities/merge-text, workflow-utilities/split-text): their parameters and the output ports other workflow steps reference.

model.description: Model slug in "owner/model" format, e.g. "google/veo3-1", "black-forest-labs/flux-2-pro", or a workflow utility such as "workflow-utilities/output-filter".

name: get_model_schema

discountPercent.description: Your discount on this model, in percent. It comes off the part of a charge paid from deposits; coupon credit and store revenue pay first, at the list price in pricing.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Estimated USD cost of one run: the average of past runs for a model billed by run time, or the listed estimate of a price set when the run ends. Null when there is no such estimate, as for a model priced by its options: see pricing.

default.description: What a run uses when the parameter is left out.

sample.description: The value from the model's page. A workflow step that leaves the parameter out gets it. A run does not: it leaves an optional parameter empty (a seed is picked at random) and refuses a required one that is left out.

pricingNotes.description: Notes from the model's price list, as its page shows them, such as the rates behind a price or the setting it applies to.

title: Get a Wiro model schema
